role: proposed hidden-world ranges (grader side only). Robot properties stay fixed; only fluid-vehicle interaction coefficients and the environment vary.
sampling: lam_A ~ U(0,1) blends added mass linearly between set A (wu2018) and set B (vonbenzon2022); lam_D ~ U(0,1) blends damping (linear terms linearly, quadratic terms in log space); then each coefficient gets an independent multiplicative jitter exp(U(-j, j)). Draw ONCE per task world (one layout), not per episode.

environment.current: task-specific; see uwkit.dynamics.current (uniform / layered / tidal / Gauss-Markov / wake)
